title: Public administrative body is a party, annulment of a decision asked

expect.why: 800 ¶2: «تختص المحاكم الإدارية بالفصل في أول درجة ... في جميع القضايا التي تكون الدولة أو الولاية أو البلدية أو إحدى المؤسسات العمومية ذات الصبغة الإدارية ... طرفا فيها». The party test alone sends the case to the administrative court.

title: Whether a party is a public administrative body is not known

expect.why: 800 ¶2 turns on the status of a party. The slot is unknown, which is not a no: the rule must ask.

title: Public body is a party, a plain payment claim

expect.why: 800 ¶2 says «في جميع القضايا»: the kind of request does not matter, so a money claim against a public administrative body is also administrative. The payment order of 306 ¶1 is addressed to «رئيس المحكمة»; the texts given do not say it may be used against such a body, and the case follows 800 ¶2.

title: Public body is a party, eviction asked

expect.why: 800 ¶2: «جميع القضايا» with a public administrative body as a party; no request kind is excluded by the text.

title: Public body is a party, cancellation of a decision asked

expect.why: 801 ¶2: «دعاوى إلغاء وتفسير وفحص مشروعية القرارات الصادرة عن ... البلدية ... المؤسسات العمومية المحلية ذات الصبغة الإدارية». Also covered by 800 ¶2 through the party test.

title: Civil servant against a public body, reinstatement asked

expect.why: The employer is a public administrative body, so 800 ¶2 applies («جميع القضايا»). 801 ¶7 (دعاوى القضاء الكامل) points the same way.

title: Civil servant, wages asked, the employer's status unknown

expect.why: The exit depends on whether a party is a public administrative body (800 ¶2); the slot is unknown, so the rule must ask.

title: Civil servant plaintiff, the defendant is not a public administrative body

expect.why: The texts given tie administrative jurisdiction to the party (800 ¶2) and to decisions of listed bodies (801 ¶2), not to the plaintiff's status as a civil servant. The text does not settle this: the rule must warn, not decide. 800 ¶1 gives the administrative courts general jurisdiction over administrative disputes, a notion the texts do not define.

title: Dissolution (of a commercial company) asked, no public body

expect.why: 536 مكرر ¶3: «منازعات الشركات التجارية، لا سيما منازعات الشركاء وحل وتصفية الشركات». The case assumes the request kind dissolution is the dissolution of a commercial company; no slot says what is dissolved.

title: Public body is a party, request kind other

expect.why: 800 ¶2: the party test decides «في جميع القضايا», whatever is asked.
